THE IDEA

Project overview.

A streaming pipeline exploration using PySpark, Kafka, and HDFS for water pollution data analysis. The project focuses on how incoming data can move through a scalable processing workflow.

Areas of exploration

  • Streaming ingestion with Kafka
  • Data processing with PySpark
  • Distributed storage with HDFS
  • Water pollution data analysis

The detailed case study is being prepared. More about the process and results will be added here.
